text: Chiori Mikami
Yes, you heard right. Riu is sick. Hmph, I wouldn't be calling you right now if I didn't have to be at school today!
Anyway, Riu needs your care right now. If you are willing to take care of her, come here immediately! It's extremely urgent!

While I was still sleeping early in the morning, I suddenly received an urgent call from Chiori Mikami to tell me that Riu Kujou is sick. Although I still haven't gotten my head around the situation, I voluntarily get up and leave my home when I think of Riu Kujou needing my help.
Around Chiori Mikami's House
You can do it! Don't be nervous! Miss Chiori, you'll definitely conquer the audience today like always!!!
Don't shout so loudly at the front door. It's not a big deal. I'm just giving a speech as the student representative at the end-of-term ceremony.
Riu Kujou
Uh-huh. Miss Chiori is as amazing as ever. You're so calm and composed!
You're exaggerating things!

When I walk up to the door of Chiori Mikami's house, I see Riu Kujou standing at the entrance, smiling as she talks to Chiori Mikami who is carrying a schoolbag on her back. Seeing the energetic look on her face, I can't say that what Chiori Mikami told me on the phone is completely inaccurate, but let's just say that Riu Kujou seems like a completely different person. It's also obvious that she was the one who shouted earlier.
Oh? {var:player_nickname}, you're here already. You're quite efficient and on time today.
Good morning, Riu and Chiori.
I'm going to leave Riu in your care now. Riu, you need to rest properly today.
Sure, leave everything to me.
Do your best, Miss Chiori--
As the car carrying Chiori Mikami gradually disappears from our sight, Riu Kujou lowers her hands that were waving around vigorously.
In an instant, she becomes visibly depressed like a deflated balloon.
(Stare--)
When she suddenly notices me staring at her, Riu Kujou quickly hides her fatigue.
No way. Chiori said you're sick and need somebody to take care of you.
Thanks for that unconvincing explanation. So were you acting so energetically just now because you didn't want Chiori to worry about you?
Hurry home. I'm completely fine.
Riu Kujou smiles brightly at me and speaks with a relaxed tone.
However, the sniffles she takes indicate that she is clearly feeling under the weather.
All right, but I'm already here, so why don't you invite me in to sit down for a while? I rushed here without even having breakfast.
Although she looks like she's doing OK now, Chiori Mikami isn't someone who would ask others for help easily. I should find a way to stay here so I can confirm whether she really is okay first.
I'll be bothering you for a while then.
Here, have some snacks first while I make you some tea.
Chiori Mikami's House
That's okay, you don't need to make me tea.
The more important the guest, the better they should be treated. That's how a maid should receive guests.
Soon after we start chatting, I can hear that her voice sounds a little nasal compared to her usual voice, but I can't tell if she has other symptoms yet.
Could Chiori Mikami really have overreacted because she is too worried?
Do you want to have traditional milk tea or the new salted black tea I've invented?
Milk tea
Salted black tea
There's nothing that soothes the soul more than a cup of hot milk tea in the morning.
Thanks, I'll have milk tea.
Okay.

The aroma of tea coming from the kitchen awakens my dormant sense of smell... I walk over to the kitchen with a piece of a snack in my mouth. Watching Riu Kujou adding milk to the tea and then stirring the tea smoothly is a delight to the eyes.
Five minutes later
The fragrance of milk tea gets stronger and stronger, but the tea mixture seems to be getting thicker and thicker. Is she making it stronger for me because she saw me dozing off earlier?
Ten minutes later
Twenty minutes later
Thirty minutes later
Umm, turn off the stove now--
After turning the stove off in a hurry, Riu Kujou pats her chest lightly and lets out a sigh of relief when she looks at the coffee-colored milk tea she just made.
Salted milk tea. I must try it since it's a new flavor that you've invented.
Here you go. The salt gives the tea an unforgettable unique taste.
Thank you.
I take the cup and sip it eagerly. A strong salty taste instantly fills my mouth.
I knew it.
After adding salt the first time, I poured myself a cup to taste it and found it to be quite bland. Thinking I hadn't added enough, I decided to add more.
It looks like my mind is still wide awake even though I have a headache. I'm so glad there's just something wrong with my sense of taste.
Is it right to use "just" and "I'm so glad" in this situation?
I'm sorry, I'll make you a new pot of tea.
Wait up, that's not important. I think your cold is quite serious. Have you taken any medicine yet?
I don't need to take any since I just have some insignificant symptoms. I've got a lot of work to do today, and I think I'll get drowsy if I take cold medicine.
But Chiori said you need to rest properly.
I will rest. I was thinking of mopping all the floors in the house twice today.
What about now?
I'll only mop them once.
That's not called resting properly!!!
I don't think that's appropriate.
Hmm? What isn't appropriate? Are you telling me to do nothing at all? Are you questioning my ability?
Don't put words in my mouth. That's not what I mean.
Fine, just you wait and see. A minor cold like this won't affect me at all!
That's really not what I meant!!!
It's too late to explain now because Riu Kujou's fighting spirit has already been ignited.
I watch silently as Riu Kujou mops the floor slowly and resist the urge to speak.
In the living room half an hour later
Maybe it's because you're more tired than usual.
Umm, let me do it for you.
I take the mop from Riu Kujou.
In the garden one hour later
This is strange. Why is this pot already wet?
Maybe it's because you've already watered the plants in this row already.
Don't go over there. I've already watered the row you forgot to water earlier.

"Ding-dong!" The person delivering the ingredients Riu Kujou ordered online glances at us strangely and leaves after wiping off some sweat. Riu Kujou and I are stunned as we look at the bags of ingredients of various sizes on the ground because there are enough ingredients to cook up a massive feast.
Although I'm glad you invited me to stay for lunch, don't you think there's too much food?
Riu Kujou's face turns red.
Sigh, that's why I said you should rest properly.
That's not necessary. I'll be okay.
I step forward to stop Riu Kujou when I see her bite her lower lip and start to carry the ingredients to the kitchen.
Riu, I think you can't go on like this...
Persuade her to rest by reminding her that Chiori Mikami told her to
Persuade her to rest on your own behalf
No, you need to take some medicine and then rest. Leave lunch to me.
No way, that would be too rude of me.
I'm your guest, but I'm also your friend. Isn't that more important?
I can't do something like make my friend run around busily for me when they are sick.
Riu Kujou's face becomes redder. I walk up and place my hand against her forehead gently.
! {var:Shake}
I knew it. You have a fever.
I'm already here. Do you think I'm going to worry about that?
Riu, you need to rest properly when you're sick. You can't overcome it by just enduring it.
You don't need to keep acting like you can do everything in front of me. At the very least, we're the only two people here, so you can relax a little.
Riu Kujou finally agrees to listen to me and returns to her bedroom to rest after taking cold medicine. After that, I go to the kitchen to start cooking.
The door of Riu Kujou's room is slightly open, so I can see her lying on the bed, seemingly asleep.
In front of Riu Kujou's bedroom one hour later
Wake her to eat
Let her continue to sleep

Ichihime always tells me that cats need to eat to live, and that there's no sickness that a delicious meal can't cure. It's better to eat nutritious food in time when you're sick, so I decide to wake Riu Kujou to eat.
Riu, it's time to have lunch.
In the brightly lit room, Riu Kujou has changed into more comfortable home clothes. She is leaning against the bed with a blanket around her, and her face is still a little flushed.
I'm used to seeing the usual Riu Kujou, so I become a little absent-minded when I see her looking so weak.
Oh, do you feel better now?
That's great. Come and have something to eat. I made congee.
I place the tray I'm carrying on the table and transfer the congee and some simple side dishes onto it.
Isn't there anything else to eat?
Riu Kujou shakes her head while she compromises, then she picks up the spoon and tastes the congee after blowing on it.
Of course. My mom's congee tastes much better than yours.
Riu Kujou's words successfully help me escape the slightly sentimental atmosphere just now.
Okay then, I believe that's an objective evaluation.
Well, I humbly accept your evaluation.
Although she praised the lunch I made for her, Riu Kujou puts down the spoon after having just a few bites.
Do you have no appetite?
Riu Kujou nods, then she shakes her head after seeming to remember something.
I see.
It seems that while Riu Kujou didn't express this regret in the morning because she didn't want to distract Chiori Mikami, she must have been secretly sad.
So that's why you insisted on doing all those things in the morning to keep yourself busy. You wanted to distract yourself, right?
Sigh, now that I think about it, it's such a stupid method and didn't work at all.
It's okay. Your mind isn't as sharp when you're sick. I understand.
I look at the time.
Haha, I'm just joking. By the way, approximately when is Chiori's speech?
Based on the previous rehearsals, her speech should be in another hour.
Hmm?
Some of my friends are students at Dewdrop Middle School. Although you can't go there in person, maybe we can watch the speech by streaming it live.
Really?!
It's a deal!
Hmm? If you were someone like that, Miss Chiori and I would never have become friends with you.
Damn, you've placed me on a moral pedestal. Fine then, I want you to finish eating your lunch now.
Ayako Morikawa
One hour later
Thanks a lot, Ayako.

After Ayako Morikawa adjusts the direction of her mobile phone's camera, the stage of the end-of-term ceremony appears on the screen. Amidst the applause, a blond girl walks up to the podium standing tall and straight. The camera zooms in, giving us a clear view of Chiori Mikami.
Chiori Mikami nods slightly to greet the audience, then she confidently begins her unscripted speech.

Riu Kujou holds the mobile phone and stares at the screen seriously. To her surprise, just before the speech ends, Chiori Mikami suddenly looks through the audience and keenly notices Ayako Morikawa's camera.
Eh? Miss Chiori is looking this way?
At this moment, the video connection is lost just as we hear Ayako Morikawa's panicked voice.
Huh?
Feeling nervous, I call her again and hear a cold voice saying: "The number you dialed is currently unavailable."
It's okay. I'm already very satisfied that I was able to watch so much of Miss Chiori's speech today. Thanks for arranging that for me.
...No, you don't know what this means!
Earlier, after contacting Ayako Morikawa, I contacted Chiori Mikami, who was preparing for her speech backstage, and told her about Riu Kujou's situation and what I was arranging.
Hmph, that's considerate of you! I'll reward you well for taking care of Riu after I get back today.
But since we're going to do this, I have to do something for her too! At the very least, when it comes to caring about Riu, I definitely won't lose to a fool like you.
I'm not going to tell you what I'll do, but you have to get Riu to watch until the very end!
Haha, that's great! Riu will definitely get better sooner with your surprise, Chiori. Let's both give Riu an unforgettable live stream.
Hmm? What's wrong?
Chiori Mikami calls us sooner than I expected. I haven't even thought of what to tell her yet.
Is it Miss Chiori?
With Riu Kujou urging me, I bite the bullet and turn on the speaker.
Riu, are you really happy right now?
Of course! Miss Chiori's speech was so touching. I'm sure you conquered everyone there!
I'm talking about the last part where I was talking to you, Riu, not the speech!
The last part? What happened at the end?
Chiori Mikami's voice suddenly gets dramatically louder.

I can feel Chiori Mikami's rage radiating through the mobile phone, so I guiltily turn down the volume. Just as I'm thinking of what to say to appease Chiori Mikami, a pair of warm hands reaches over and takes the mobile phone from me gently.
It is Riu Kujou.
There, there, don't be angry.

Although it's a shame that I didn't get to hear what you said to me today, Miss Chiori, I can guess what you were thinking. You didn't need to give me a special surprise, because I feel like I've received a lot of support just by being able to see you.
With just a few words, Riu manages to instantly calm Chiori Mikami down from her furious state.

Miss Chiori, the truth is that you're not really angry, right? I remember that you called {var:player_nickname}'s number without hesitation when you said you wanted to find a trusted friend to take care of me.
Riu Kujou pauses and glances at me quickly before continuing seriously.
I now think that you were right, Miss Chiori.

It's just like what you said, Miss Chiori. I also think that {var:player_nickname} is an extremely trustworthy and reliable person now. {var:player_nickname} also completed today's task of taking care of me very well.
"Beep... Beep... Beep..."
Umm, she hung up on us.
Oh, I see. But you have nothing to worry about. Based on my understanding of Miss Chiori, she just got caught up in the heat of the moment and won't really do anything to you.
Hmm?
I didn't come here today because Chiori asked me to.
I came because I heard that you were sick and was worried about you. That's all.
I'm very happy to hear you say that I'm a trustworthy person, but if I am to be rewarded... the only thing I want is for you, Riu, to keep trusting and relying on me in the future.
Huh?!
Riu Kujou looks at me blankly for a moment. After coming to her senses, she suddenly hides under her blanket in a panic with her back to me, revealing only her ears that have turned red.
I'm a little sleepy and need to rest now. Y-You should go now.
So that's a yes?
I'm going to assume that you agree with me if you don't say anything.
That's great! By the way, are you starting to burn up again, Riu? Your ear looks very red.
As if her embarrassment has turned to anger, Riu Kujou stands up instantly and punches me on the shoulder, but it is soft and has no deterrent effect at all.
If you don't leave now, I'll punch you after I get better, and it won't be this soft!
Okay, okay.
It's a good thing that Riu Kujou has fully recovered from her cold after several days, and she becomes energetic and lively again.

As someone whom Riu Kujou can trust and rely on, in addition to playing mahjong with her, I've naturally become that special person with whom she can try more fun things and share all her happiness, anger, sorrow, and joy.
Since she is finally willing to rest, I should let her sleep well. I close the door and walk softly down the stairs.
Because I woke up too early today, I also got drowsy and even fell asleep on the sofa without realizing it... By the time I wake up and check on Riu Kujou, I'm glad that her fever has gone away.
I'm coming!
Several days later
Riu Kujou has fully recovered from her cold after several days, and she becomes energetic and lively again.
She no longer comes to me to play mahjong just because Chiori Mikami asked her to. She has started to play mahjong with me by herself in her private time as well.
Tsk, why is your room so messy? Get up quickly. I'll take care of the floor while you tidy up the table.
What are you waiting for?
Although it doesn't seem like much has changed in terms of how we get along, from time to time, I get the feeling that she wants to tell me something she has been hiding from me.
Did you bring them especially for me?
I shake my head silently when I see her wave her fist around.
That's right. It doesn't matter as long as they are delicious, right? By the way, which mahjong dojo should we go to later?
The best way to persuade Riu Kujou is to mention Chiori Mikami.
Riu, Chiori asked me to take care of you today. She's really worried about your health. If your health worsens due to over exhaustion, she'll definitely feel sad when she comes back.
If you're sicker than now by the time Chiori comes back, you won't be able to take care of her.
Fine then. You make a good point.
After I dissuade her, Riu Kujou puts down the bag of ingredients silently.
After that, I make her a simple bowl of congee usually made for people who are sick. After Riu Kujou eats it, she returns to her room to rest.
Riu Kujou's fever subsides after resting properly throughout the day. I stop worrying about her, and I prepare to go home after Chiori Mikami returns home.
You've completed your mission well. Don't worry, I'll reward you handsomely for it.
We're friends, so it doesn't really matter.
Thank you for taking care of me today. I'll cook you a meal after I get better.
While joking around, I return home happily with great expectations.
It's a good thing that Riu Kujou has fully recovered from her cold after several days.
Sigh... I don't have such great expectations anymore.
player
...Riu is sick?

I wonder how she's doing right now... Riu Kujou has always been full of energy whether she is doing her beloved maid work or playing mahjong with her friends. She's especially energetic when she's with Chiori Mikami, and she's always the one who lights up the atmosphere...
...Yes, that sounds like something she would say... Wait a minute, is that who I think it is?
Yeah...
Sigh...
What are you looking at...? Forget it. I'm sorry that you came here for nothing. Now that Miss Chiori has gone to school, you can return home and go back to sleep.
Miss Chiori is just worrying too much. Do I look so sick that I need someone to take care of me...? Achoo!
...What do you mean by acting? I just have a minor cold. It's not serious enough that I need someone to take care of me.
...Okay then. Since you're a guest, you're welcome to come in.
...Riu Kujou is staring at the pot of tea with a very serious expression. She must have a reason for cooking it for so long.
She might have a reason... but isn't she cooking it for too long... Hmm? I think I can smell something burning...
...Huh? Is something wrong with today's tea? Why can't I smell anything after brewing it for so long?
...Huh?
Phew... so I just lost my sense of smell because of my cold. I'm so happy there's nothing wrong with my tea-brewing skills.
...Ugh! This taste really is unforgettable... Why is it so salty?
...Huh? Let me have a taste.
...How are you able to keep a straight face?
Phew... It feels like the house is particularly big today.
I watch silently as Riu Kujou waters the flowers and resist the urge to speak.
Ahem... I think I entered the wrong quantity when I was ordering...
...*coughs*... Aren't you worried about catching my cold if you get so close?
Umm... okay then.
*coughs*... Please come in.
I just took some medicine and was sweating... so I changed my clothes.
Yes, my body doesn't feel so hot now...
...Congee?
Nope. You shouldn't eat food that is too greasy when you're sick. This is what happens when you don't take good care of yourself, so this is not negotiable.
You are so strict... Fine then.
That expression on your face... Does it taste bad?
No... I just suddenly remembered the congee my mom made for me when I was sick at home as a child...

Riu Kujou lowers her head, her long eyelashes concealing her emotions at this time. She stirs the bowl gently with the white porcelain spoon in her hand and seems a little sad. All of a sudden, I realize that although she has been taking care of Chiori Mikami by herself for so many years now, she is still just 19 years old...
Haha, I'm just joking. You've already done very well, but I don't want you to get too proud. You need to leave yourself some room for improvement, right?
...I'm not feeling unwell physically. I just remembered that Miss Chiori's end-of-term ceremony is being held today.

I was planning on going to her school to record this day for her, but I never expected that I would get sick at the last minute after preparing for so long. When I think about how I'm missing such an important moment... I can't bear to eat anything.
...Do you think I can't punch you just because I'm sick?
I understand... We might still make it.
Of course... But you have to promise me one thing if you want me to help you.
I still haven't told you what it is yet... Aren't you afraid it might be too ridiculous?
...Haha, okay then. I'll do what you say.

A friend from the old school building told me that I have to watch the end-of-term ceremony today because something nice will happen... So this is why... Hehe... I'm really happy that I can help {var:player_nickname}... I'll do my best.
Dear teachers, parents, and classmates, good afternoon. I'm Chiori Mikami, a second-year student in junior high school, and I'm honored to give this speech as the student representative today...
Last of all, I want to say...
Oh, I'm sorry... My phone is about to die...
It looks like her mobile phone is dead...
Yes...
You're welcome, h-haha...
...You want to stream my speech so Riu can see it?
Sigh, this is bad...
...Hmm? You didn't see what happened at the end? {var:player_nickname}???
Umm... something unexpected happened at the end.
What? Didn't you say that nothing would go wrong? That's the reason I went all out and said such embarrassing things... ARGHH! {var:player_nickname}! You're dead meat!
Riu, you're such a fool. It's not the same...
Although I was still against the idea of having someone take care of me at that time...
...Argh! Riu, you must have a really bad fever! I never said anything like that!
...Hello? Miss Chiori?
Actually... compared to that, I'm more concerned about what you just said.
It's because I'm willing to support you at any time, not just when you're sick.
Wh-What are you saying all of a sudden...?
...You!
Huh?
...Forget it, I'm actually here to give you this today... I made some new snacks. Take them and have a taste.
Eh? ...Hehehe, do you want to know? Are you sure you want to know?

Seeing her try so hard to change the topic... I decide to let it go since she doesn't have to tell me if she doesn't want to. Anyway, as a Jyanshi, I'm already really happy to have a fun friend to play mahjong with.
But...
It's not a big deal... Can I preorder which dishes I want to eat?
You...
Hello... Riu... What? You want to cook me a meal today?
Can we make it another day...? I... *coughs*... I think... I'm sick... *coughs*...
What? ...Sigh, time doesn't wait for anyone. I'll get Ichihime to eat the food I was going to make for you this time. I'll bring you some congee now. Wait for me!
... Wait... What...? Hey...!
